summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature without running tests or committing. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch now yields (patch view, coordinate array) pairs computed from padded-frame slices; set_rnd skips double-underscore attributes), monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter generator; GridPatchDataset reworked to take patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates; NotImplementedError for missing len; np.ceil worker split; per-patch apply_transform; math import removed; np.float fixed to float in PatchDataset docstring), monai/data/__init__.py (exports PatchIter), docs/source/data.rst (PatchIter autodoc entry), and new tests/test_grid_dataset.py (test_shape, test_loading_array, plus an extra test_missing_length). Choices to review: set_determinism(1234) is called in setUp only, not again in test_loading_array; the docstring example shows four printed batches (my reading of the setup); pre-existing lines over 120 chars in get_valid_patch_size were left untouched. Tests are unverified because execution was disallowed.
